authority: This artifact is the only merge-gating requirement-to-evidence map. GTS-13C is sequencing and rationale only.
scope: Sprints 0-6 merged evidence. Phase 2 closed under Gate R10 with zero second product harness, sealed evidence receipts R0-R10, and verified end-to-end dogfood runs.

owner_identities.acting-tech-lead: Repository principal rocha, acting as Tech Lead for this Sprint 0 setup.
owner_identities.acting-senior-developer: Repository principal rocha, acting as Senior Developer for this Sprint 0 setup.

deferred_activation.source: GTS-13C tasks not represented by an active req_id in this artifact
deferred_activation.reason: Unimplemented product and assurance rows remain inactive until their programme dependency and implementing component enter merge scope.
deferred_activation.activation_gate: Tech Lead contract amendment before implementation merge; every activated item receives its own stable req_id and evidence owner.

requirements.statement: Every source import follows the domain <- ports <- kernel <- agency <- runtime -> adapters dependency lattice and the source graph is acyclic.
requirements.rationale: A mechanically enforced lattice prevents authority inversion and architectural drift.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: python3 tools/check_boundaries.py exits 0 for the repository and non-zero for forbidden-direction and cycle fixtures.
requirements.margin: zero forbidden edges and zero cycles

requirements.statement: No module outside a disposable directory imports spike/ or slice/, and the S4 gate rejects either directory if it still exists.
requirements.rationale: Disposable experiments must be deletable without negotiating production dependencies.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Boundary checker rejects the disposable-import fixture; S4 mode checks directory absence.
requirements.margin: zero importers; zero disposable directories at S4

requirements.statement: runtime/governance imports only domain, ports and kernel and has no agency, model or adapter dependency.
requirements.rationale: Finite approvals and releases must remain deterministic, restartable and exterior to cognition.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Boundary checker reports no prohibited governance edge.
requirements.margin: zero prohibited imports

requirements.statement: agency has no adapter or evaluator dependency and no source module outside runtime imports a concrete adapter.
requirements.rationale: Cognition must not acquire a second effect path or construct its own judge.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Boundary checker reports no prohibited agency or adapter edge.
requirements.margin: zero prohibited imports

requirements.statement: Every registered must-fail control has a passing reference command and a deliberately broken counterpart that fails for the declared reason.
requirements.rationale: A gate never observed rejecting a defect is not established as a control.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: python3 tools/run_broken_tests.py emits a receipt for every manifest case and exits 0 only for the expected pass/fail pair.
requirements.margin: 100% registered broken counterparts observed failing

requirements.statement: The repository declares one authority chain, keeps the Decision Record append-only, and states that GTS-13C cannot decide contracts or gate merges.
requirements.rationale: Duplicate normative ownership makes conflicts irreconstructable.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Sprint 0 governance audit verifies artifact presence, authority text and append-only Decision Record declaration.
requirements.margin: one owner per contract

requirements.source: Sprint 0 mandate Chapter 4 Gate A; ADR-0052
requirements.statement: Every active contract row has a stable requirement ID, component, requirement owner, test owner, test ID, dependencies and expected acceptance evidence.
requirements.rationale: Baseline coverage measures accountable assignment before implementation exists.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Contract validator reports baseline_assignment_coverage=100% with unique req_id/test_id values.
requirements.margin: exactly 100%

requirements.source: Sprint 0 mandate Chapter 4 Gate B; ADR-0052
requirements.statement: Every active row for a merged component is covered by passing evidence or approved as justified with compensating assurance.
requirements.rationale: Merged implementation may not leave an open assurance obligation.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Contract validator reports merged_scope_evidence_coverage=100% and validates covered/justified evidence fields.
requirements.margin: exactly 100%

requirements.statement: The pull-request template requires valid requirement references, merged-scope evidence, boundary confirmation and the GTS-13C non-authority safeguard.
requirements.rationale: Review input must expose the same constraints that CI enforces.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Governance audit confirms all mandated PR checklist clauses.
requirements.margin: zero missing clauses

requirements.statement: Before joint baseline approval, only governance, contract, CI, repository and documentation infrastructure may use the bootstrap merge path.
requirements.rationale: Implementation cannot precede the control that is supposed to gate it.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: PR template records the bootstrap classification and requires Tech Lead plus Project Lead approval.
requirements.margin: zero product behavior in bootstrap

requirements.source: GTS-13C T1.1; VG-04 CT-04/CT-09 and D-1..D-6
requirements.statement: Canonical bytes use RFC 8785/JCS without local variation and at least 40 golden input-to-canonical-to-sha256 triples agree across readers.
requirements.rationale: Descriptor, artifact and event identity must remain byte-stable across languages.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Forty or more shared golden triples pass in both first-lock readers with identical canonical bytes and digests.
requirements.margin: zero cross-reader mismatches

requirements.statement: Every v0.1 identifier and primitive is opaque and boundary-parsed, with RFC3339 millisecond UTC timestamps, sha256 digests and safe large-integer wire forms.
requirements.rationale: Primitive confusion or lossy numeric parsing corrupts the permanent corpus.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Shared valid/invalid vectors prove parse, rejection and round-trip behavior for every primitive.
requirements.margin: zero casts at external boundaries

requirements.source: GTS-13C T1.3; VG-04 CT-24..CT-28/CT-52; field inventory decision 1
requirements.statement: ResourceSelector uses VG-04's per-kind total inclusion relation, denies cross-kind and undefined comparisons, and satisfies reflexivity, transitivity and antisymmetry up to canonical equality.
requirements.rationale: Pattern approximation or a verb-only model silently widens authority.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Property tests cover every selector kind and must-fail vectors cover unknown and cross-kind pairs.
requirements.margin: zero unknown-as-allow outcomes

requirements.source: GTS-13C T1.4; ADR-0051; VG-04 §5.5; field inventory GAP-003
requirements.statement: EffectDescriptor carries verb, explicit sink class, selector, canonical args and digest, idempotency key, risk, provenance and sufficient execution context to bind cwd-dependent calls.
requirements.rationale: Recording, mediation and approval depend on the exact normalized call being explicit data.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Descriptor vectors prove normalization, provider-call-ID exclusion, cwd semantics and sink-class parsing.
requirements.margin: zero semantically equal calls with different digests

requirements.statement: CapabilityGrant requires principal, exact descriptor digest, scoped resources/actions, purpose, expiry, uses, budget lease and authenticated parent/approval data where applicable.
requirements.rationale: A grant not bound to one exact call cannot be verified at the point of effect.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Parsing rejects missing descriptor binding and invalid constraints; conformance vectors cover valid parent/approval forms.
requirements.margin: zero grant forms without descriptor binding

requirements.source: GTS-13C T1.6; VG-03 §9; field inventory GAP-005/GAP-009
requirements.statement: Receipt represents ok, failed and undeterminable outcomes, optional grant linkage for non-privileged effects, observed time, result digest, affected-resource pre/post evidence and scoped uncertainty reason.
requirements.rationale: Recovery must preserve uncertainty and reconstruction must see every created, changed or deleted resource.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Vectors cover all outcomes, non-privileged receipts, affected-resource deltas and unknown occurrence without coercion.
requirements.margin: zero unknown outcomes coerced to success/failure

requirements.source: GTS-13C T1.7; VG-04 §12.1; field inventory GAP-007/GAP-008
requirements.statement: EventEnvelope preserves VG-04 scope-conditional identities, causal and trace order, principal plus role-at-action, tenancy/data policy, environment snapshot and typed payload without synthetic episode IDs.
requirements.rationale: Episode, governance and recovery events need truthful scope and separate identity, evidence and approval state.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Conditional-schema vectors accept valid episode/governance/recovery events and reject missing or synthetic scope identities.
requirements.margin: zero fabricated scope identifiers

requirements.statement: Artifact is immutable and content-addressed, uses an extensible kind registry, distinguishes enforcement from compensation and requires compensatesFor exactly for compensation artifacts.
requirements.rationale: Mutable status inside an artifact or a closed enum makes identity and extension unsafe.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Vectors cover kind extension, compensation conditional fields and rejection of mutable state inside content-addressed artifacts.
requirements.margin: zero mutable fields in artifact digest

requirements.statement: EvidenceClaim retains the VG-04 contract and rejects empty invalidation conditions; INV-2 automatic checks remain a separate activation-time obligation rather than mutable claim state.
requirements.rationale: A claim that cannot state and operationalize refutation is inadmissible competence evidence.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Invalid vectors reject empty conditions; valid claims round-trip losslessly through both independent readers, while activation state remains outside the content-addressed claim.
requirements.margin: zero admissible claims without refutation conditions

requirements.statement: CorrectionRecord binds proposed and accepted patch digests, non-empty reason codes, magnitude, scope, episode and correcting principal role without promoting repo-scoped preference to general competence.
requirements.rationale: Correction attribution must preserve who changed what and the domain in which the lesson is valid.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Vectors cover every reason code and reject absent patch binding, empty reasons and invalid scope.
requirements.margin: zero unscoped preference/style corrections

requirements.statement: Recording identifies model cassette, runtime image, environment snapshot, seed and clock policy by immutable digest so counterfactual execution is distinguishable from state replay.
requirements.rationale: Reconstruction without frozen environmental and nondeterminism inputs cannot support re-execution claims.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Vectors reject missing recording inputs and prove stable digest/round-trip behavior across both readers.
requirements.margin: zero replay claims without a complete recording tuple

requirements.statement: ProcessDefinition and ProcessInstance declare finite states, allowed transitions, approvals, bound effect verbs and complete history sufficient for the later process engine to resume without replaying agent reasoning.
requirements.rationale: Approval, release and governance paths must remain deterministic, auditable and restartable outside cognition.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Schema vectors prove finite readable states, deterministic transition declarations and lossless ProcessInstance history reconstruction without Episode execution.
requirements.margin: zero governance transitions requiring a model

requirements.source: ICD §1/§2; GTS-13C T10.1; approved CLI architecture §1
requirements.statement: vanguard/packages contains exactly the six approved core packages, unknown package directories fail CI, and clients are outside that lattice with imports limited to domain and the runtime client surface.
requirements.rationale: Silently skipping an unknown package disables the boundary gate for precisely the code most likely to drift.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Boundary CI scans clients and rejects MF-S0-009's seventh-package fixture while the repository passes with only the approved six package directories.
requirements.margin: exactly six core package names and zero prohibited client imports

requirements.statement: The active EventStorePort has one shared behavioural contract suite, a deterministic in-memory fake, and a transactional SQLite/WAL real adapter with typed failure substitution.
requirements.rationale: An interface or fake alone does not establish that runtime implementations are substitutable on success and failure paths.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: test_event_store_port executes the same append/read/digest/conflict contract against InMemoryEventStore and SqliteEventStore.
requirements.margin: zero behavioural differences in the shared contract

requirements.statement: The kernel distinguishes principals, binds grants to exact descriptors, permits attenuation only by narrowing, emits explicit alertable denials, and conserves budget lease trees including overruns.
requirements.rationale: Authority and budget defects are silent privilege escalation unless checked as algebraic and point-of-effect invariants.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: The kernel suite covers attenuation monotonicity, descriptor substitution, replay/expiry/forgery, provenance accumulation, denial alerts, and budget conservation/overrun debit.
requirements.margin: zero widening, unbound grants, silent denials, or unaccounted budget

requirements.statement: Dispatch enumerates every failure, writes durable intent before effect execution, records every sink class, mediates privileged sinks with descriptor-bound grants, and preserves conservative provenance and undeterminable occurrence.
requirements.rationale: A second dispatch path, late intent, or uncertainty coercion destroys attribution at the trust boundary.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: The dispatch suite covers the complete failure table and MF-KRN-008..010 prove rejection of sink weakening, missing records, and dispatch-before-intent defects.
requirements.margin: zero unrecorded effects and zero privileged effects without a verified grant

requirements.statement: Policy-kernel source size is measured against a reviewed baseline, growth raises an alarm, and each kernel design change carries a reconstructable ADR.
requirements.rationale: An unmeasured TCB expands until auditability is only an assertion.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: check_tcb_budget emits the per-file 1,307-line baseline receipt, MF-KRN-011 proves the alarm fires, and ADR-0054 records the dispatch decision and reversal condition.
requirements.margin: review alarm at 131 lines above the measured baseline; growth is reviewed, not silently prohibited

requirements.statement: The event ledger provides transactional monotonic append, a pure associative reducer, digest-identical reconstruction, rebuildable projections, and correlation-preserving JSONL export with redaction.
requirements.rationale: The ledger is the source of reconstruction truth; caches and exports must never become alternate histories.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: T3 contract and randomized property suites prove atomic rollback, monotonic sequence, batch associativity, state digest replay, projection rebuild, and correlation-preserving export/import.
requirements.margin: zero replay digest divergence and zero partially committed batches

requirements.statement: Recovery writes terminal records from outside the failed process, reconciliation preserves undeterminable occurrence, and model cassettes replay byte-identical recorded results without I/O.
requirements.rationale: A corpse cannot report its own death and ambiguous external occurrence cannot be converted into invented certainty.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: T3 recovery, reconciliation, cassette, and property tests cover expired external leases, immutable uncertainty, and byte-identical cassette replay.
requirements.margin: zero terminal records authored by the dying worker and zero coerced uncertain outcomes

requirements.source: GTS-13C T6.4 fast-track scaffold; approved CLI/TUI architecture
requirements.statement: The CLI client provides mock-backed run, trace and why command flows plus headless JSONL and an interactive Ink view behind one replaceable runtime-client boundary, without importing backend packages directly.
requirements.rationale: An early operator surface shortens integration feedback only if its mock vocabulary cannot become a second backend contract.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: CLI tests exercise deterministic headless run/trace/why, cancel, resume and checkpoint flows; boundary CI confirms the client remains outside core packages. 2026-08-15: npm --workspace @vanguard/cli test 3/3 pass.
requirements.margin: zero direct kernel/agency/ports/adapter imports and stable JSONL output

requirements.statement: A disposable end-to-end slice executes a prompt -> model -> patch -> approval -> apply -> test -> result path against a real repository, records live integration findings in slice-findings.md, remains unimportable by production code, and is deleted at S4.
requirements.rationale: Early live integration proves the entire vertical path before the permanent harness is built while preserving zero production coupling.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Disposable slice executes live path, emits slice-findings.md, and boundary check confirms zero production imports.
requirements.margin: zero production dependencies on slice/
requirements.justification: Disposable slice/ was fully retired and deleted at Sprint 4 under S4-GATE-001 per design.
requirements.compensating_assurance: tools/check_boundaries.py permanently enforces zero disposable slice/ or spike/ imports across all production source files.

requirements.statement: Wire schemas produce strict writer profiles, forward-compatible reader profiles, dual-language TypeScript/Python agreement on shared golden vectors, and surviving readers under minor migration bumps.
requirements.rationale: Dual-language reader conformance is the only defense against silent wire format drift across independent consumers.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Both TypeScript and Python readers agree on 100% of golden vector fixtures and survive forward-compatibility minor bumps.
requirements.margin: zero vector disagreements and zero unpreserved unknown fields in readers

requirements.statement: The artifact graph represents mutable components as typed content-addressed files, supports new kinds via registry extension without core changes, and freezes immutable HarnessManifests per episode at composition.
requirements.rationale: Harnesses must be declarative configuration rather than custom codebases to allow rigorous benchmarking and counterfactual replay.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Artifact registry resolves new kinds without kernel changes; HarnessManifest freezes at composition and reproduces identical state digests.
requirements.margin: zero runtime manifest mutations and zero core changes for kind extension

requirements.statement: The permanent vg-shell-only baseline manifest is registered, flagged undeletable, and runnable against the fake environment as the standing zero-assumption experimental control.
requirements.rationale: Without a permanent zero-assumption baseline, empirical gains from typed tools, skills, and context policies cannot be measured.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: vg-shell-only manifest is registered, rejected for deletion, and executes successfully against the fake environment.
requirements.margin: zero deletions or modifications of the permanent baseline manifest

requirements.statement: The episode loop reduces observe-propose-authorise-effect-receipt on a cassette or fake model, records every effect through Kernel.dispatch, terminates without requesting evaluation, and forbids cognitive identifiers in agency/.
requirements.rationale: A first deterministic slice proves the loop against the existing kernel before a real provider can mask missing control flow.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Cassette-driven episode reaches a terminal run state; no evaluator call; agency identifier lint clean. 2026-08-15: test/agency 23/23 pass.
requirements.margin: zero self-evaluation paths and zero kernel bypasses

requirements.statement: A ProcessInstance advances only through declared transitions, blocks on pending approvals, and after interruption resumes to the same state from the ledger without executing an episode.
requirements.rationale: Privileged git apply in beta needs a human-readable finite process, not an agent loop.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Restart-resume property: interrupted instance reconstitutes identical currentState without ModelPort. 2026-08-15: test/runtime 3/3 pass.
requirements.margin: zero governance transitions requiring a model

requirements.statement: ModelPort lands only as an activation bundle: interface, shared contract suite, and deterministic fake or cassette. Instrument errors are typed values, never task failures.
requirements.rationale: An interface without a fake is not a port. Live OpenRouter is a later row.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Shared suite passes against the fake/cassette; rate-limit fixture is instrument_error. 2026-08-15: test_model_port 3/3 pass.
requirements.margin: zero live network in this row

requirements.statement: EnvironmentAdapter lands as interface, fake, and shared suite covering snapshot, observe, preview including new files, apply, reconcile and dispose. Test commands are argv arrays.
requirements.rationale: Slice findings showed model text is not a patch and shell strings are an injection surface.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Fake adapter suite covers preview-of-new-file and argv test; no shell string accepted.
requirements.margin: zero path-escape applies

requirements.statement: EvaluatorPort lands as interface, fake, and suite. Agency has no import path to it. Fake evaluator identity is enough for Sprint 4; OS isolation is Sprint 5.
requirements.rationale: The trust-spine needs a principal the episode cannot reach without waiting on a container runtime.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Boundary check forbids agency to evaluator; fake evaluate returns inconclusive on instrument error. 2026-08-15: test_evaluator_port 3/3 pass.
requirements.margin: zero agency evaluator imports

requirements.statement: SandboxRunner lands as interface, visibly marked non-contained fake, and suite that refuses to publish when the containment report is unverified.
requirements.rationale: Perimeter implementation is Sprint 4b; the port and fail-closed publication rule start in Sprint 3.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Fake runner marks unverified; publication helper returns blocked. 2026-08-15: test_sandbox_port 2/2 pass.
requirements.margin: zero unpublished-unverified results treated as shipped

requirements.statement: A production OpenRouter (OpenAI-compatible) adapter implements ModelPort, uses secret references only, records cassettes, and is not instantiated by the no-model trust-spine command.
requirements.rationale: Beta needs a real LLM; Increment A must remain model-free. Slice code is never imported.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Cassette tests pass without network; live optional test is skipped when the key is unset; trust-spine CI has no adapter import. 2026-08-15: test_openrouter 4/4 pass (1 skipped live).
requirements.margin: zero secrets in events or exports

requirements.source: ADR-0048; GTS-13C T4.1-T4.7; VG-08 Increment A
requirements.statement: A scripted trajectory with no model dependency proves denial, attenuation, budget exhaustion, event atomicity, kill recovery, secret non-disclosure, and that spike/ and slice/ are absent after the S4 exit.
requirements.rationale: Model behaviour must not become a prerequisite of kernel verification.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: test.trust.test_spine passes with OPENROUTER_API_KEY unset; MF-S4-001 absence check green. 2026-08-15: test_spine 22/22 pass.
requirements.margin: zero model imports on the gate path

requirements.statement: A worker perimeter produces a containment report from mount, egress and syscall probes; an unverified report blocks publication of any result from that run.
requirements.rationale: Inferred containment is not containment.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Probes recorded; unverified publication denied; worker cannot read evaluator bundle in the scoped fixture. 2026-08-15: broken harness and test_rootless_sandbox pass.
requirements.margin: zero inferred-from-config containment claims

requirements.statement: vg-code-default is registered as the beta product manifest with typed read/search/patch/test; vg-shell-only remains undeletable. Neither is a codebase.
requirements.rationale: The beta is one framework plus one harness. Reconstructions wait until Sprint 7.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Both manifests freeze at composition; deletion of vg-shell-only is rejected.
requirements.margin: zero second product harness in S3-S6

requirements.statement: An L1-L5 layered prefix-stable context compiler assembles immutable system, schema and repo-map layers with token budgeting, provenance tagging and pre-action competence prior logging.
requirements.rationale: Prefix stability maximizes KV-cache reuse economics and prevents cognitive context pollution.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: test_context_compiler and test_openrouter validate L1-L5 layer immutability, token budgeting, provenance tagging, and pre-action competence prior event emission (evidenced in docs/sprint6/evidence/R7/receipt.md).
requirements.margin: zero dynamic reordering of L1-L3 layers

requirements.statement: An exterior evaluator daemon executes in an isolated OS process (dedicated UID/image), runs bit-for-bit double probes (immutability and non-pollution), and treats instrument drops as inconclusive.
requirements.rationale: The episode must never judge its own output, and test tampering must be mechanically detected.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: test_isolated_evaluator verifies double probes (immutability/non-pollution), non-ambient privileges, and inconclusive fail-closed crash handling (evidenced in docs/sprint6/evidence/R0/receipt.md).
requirements.margin: zero evaluation authority held by the episode loop

requirements.statement: Descriptor-bound human approvals suspend privileged fs.patch effects, render normalized unified diffs to the client, and verify human signature against exact argsDigest.
requirements.rationale: Security in human-in-the-loop requires signing the exact change descriptor, not a generic permission verb.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: test_approval_flow proves descriptor-bound HMAC signature validation, tampered diff rejection (MF-GOV-001), and durable suspension replay (evidenced in docs/sprint6/evidence/R5/receipt.md).
requirements.margin: zero unsigned privileged effect execution

requirements.statement: The hexagonal CLI client consumes the live RuntimeClient async event stream, renders Ink/React diff approval modals, and records single-keystroke human corrections.
requirements.rationale: Operators require real-time visibility, deterministic replay inspection, and low-friction correction logging.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: CLI test suite verifies interactive diff approval modal, live event tree streaming, and single-keystroke correction capture without backend imports (evidenced in docs/sprint6/evidence/R0/receipt.md).
requirements.margin: zero direct core backend imports in client UI

requirements.source: GTS-13C T6.8; Ch. 10 Gate Q1+Q2; ADR-0057; ADR-0058
requirements.statement: The runtime composition root (runtime/root.py) composes vg-code-default against a real repository and successfully diagnoses, patches, requests approval, and passes tests on a real single-file bug.
requirements.rationale: The Beta MVP milestone is proven only when the end-to-end composite harness resolves a real coding task.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Dogfood validation runner (tools/run_dogfood_r9.py) proves 3 complete end-to-end runs diagnosing, patching, externally approving, and verifying green tests via exterior evaluator on preregistered bug with zero human source edits (evidenced in docs/sprint6/evidence/R9/receipt.md).
requirements.margin: zero human source code edits during dogfood run
